mutationRecovery.title: Machine mutation recovery
mutationRecovery.warning: Release only removes the execution fence. It does not retry or prove the original operation succeeded. Independently verify the remote effects first.
mutationRecovery.refreshRequired: Writes are blocked. Refresh and review the current state before starting a new action.
mutationRecovery.failed: The request failed. Refresh and review the current state.
mutationRecovery.unknown: The result is unknown. Do not repeat this action; refresh and inspect the remote effects.
mutationRecovery.required: Confirm both resources have stopped, choose an outcome and enter a valid observation time and note.
mutationRecovery.producerStopped: I have independently verified the producer has stopped
mutationRecovery.resourcesStopped: I have independently verified the related resources have stopped
mutationRecovery.releaseConfirm: Release this execution fence using the selected evidence? This neither retries the operation nor confirms its success.
mutationRecovery.noItemsDescription: No machine mutations currently require manual review or release.
mutationRecovery.noEvidence: No independent evidence has been recorded.
mutationRecovery.evidenceHelp: Both stop confirmations, the observed outcome, time, and note must be independently verified by an administrator.
mutationRecovery.releaseHelp: After recording evidence, explicitly choose the latest evidence and release it separately.
